scheme: AgentRx 10-category taxonomy (Barke et al., arXiv 2602.02475, MIT repo microsoft/AgentRx). NOTE: START-HERE said '9-category'; the paper's taxonomy is 10 rows (9 substantive + 10 Inconclusive). Second axis: Model-or-Harness fault localization.
